sources.snippet: Saved checkpoints at25k and50k; this repository contains the final model. The native40-step action head supervises the first32 steps and masks the tail. Relative arm actions with the gripper excluded; image augmentation enabled. Full portable recipe: train_config.json. Vision and action components trainable; language frozen.
